limitations: Profile instrumentation changes timing; use benchmark.py for latency claims.
CPU operator durations nest and must not be summed as elapsed time.
GPU interval union is timeline coverage, not SM occupancy or HBM utilization.
CPU-only captures do not contain GPU kernels.
analysis_note: Phase projection selects CPU user_annotation only; gpu_user_annotation duplicates are excluded. Captured source hashes refer to profiling-snapshots/h20.
